admission.justification: Reusing a foreign build's incomplete index can omit authored knowledge, while all build namespaces still need one bounded eviction policy.

applicability: Persistent derived knowledge-index reuse and read-only carryover lookup.
conditions: The memory-tree key, index format and immutable loaded source digest identify a reusable index.
Unknown loaded identity uses a private namespace without reuse.
Eviction accounts for all SQLite namespaces together.
exclusions: Reusing legacy tree-only files or another build's files.
Writing the derived index as authored knowledge.
Carryover building a persistent cache or updating reuse bookkeeping.

evidence: expanded-evidence-W1.md#evidence-6; cache-fd-diagnostic/IDENTITY-EVIDENCE.md and focused carryover/cache tests

statement: A persistent knowledge index is reused only for the immutable loaded source digest that built it; unknown identity uses an unshared private file and the existing eviction covers all builds.
